comments.author: @JG-no4qr
comments.text: Hi OC Patent Lawyer, I have an idea for a product I will be selling within a year.  I don't want to patent it. But neither do I want others to be able to patent it and block me from selling it. Where can I publish this invention now, where the idea is least likely to be seen, but will show up in results when patent attorneys search for prior art if someone else attempts to file a patent for it between now and when I start selling?
